title: Qualify browser numerical package roots
objective: Make every public sagejs.numerics domain explicitly available in browser lazy modules with fail-fast closure validation and real Chromium coverage

oracles: Public numerical package discovery matches explicit browser roots and compiled lazy bundle
Real Chromium imports and representative operations across every public numerical domain

runs.command: bash -lc pnpm test:baselib:strict && pnpm test:portable && node --test test/numerics/browser-packaging/closure.test.cjs && pnpm architecture:numerics && pnpm architecture:packages && node scripts/check-numerical-browser-closure.cjs --bundle packages/flint-wasm/dist/lazy-modules.json && node packages/flint-wasm/test/numerical-domains-browser.mjs && node packages/flint-wasm/scripts/production-receipt.cjs validate

bash -lc pnpm test:baselib:strict && node --test test/numerics/browser-packaging/closure.test.cjs && pnpm architecture:numerics && pnpm architecture:packages && node scripts/check-numerical-browser-closure.cjs --bundle packages/flint-wasm/dist/lazy-modules.json && node packages/flint-wasm/test/numerical-domains-browser.mjs && node packages/flint-wasm/scripts/production-receipt.cjs validate

handoff.summary: Explicitly roots all 23 numerical domain and dynamic presentation entry points, proves that the generated browser bundle contains all 67 public numerical modules, and exercises representative operations and PlotSpec witnesses in real Chromium. The final browser artifact remains within the unchanged 5% compressed-growth gate and reviewed eager-core topology ceilings.
risks: Browser Python modules are execution-lazy but lazy-modules.json is still fetched as one eager-core artifact; true network-lazy per-domain chunks require a separate packaging redesign.

Repository-wide test:changed and portable runs reached this lane's checks but stopped on stale optimizer-dashboard and parallel-lane fixtures inherited from the shared numerical branch; focused strict, architecture, closure, browser, and production-receipt checks pass.
next_steps: The integration lane should retain the explicit-root and generated-closure gates when resolving shared-branch metadata artifacts.
Consider splitting lazy-modules.json into independently fetched domain chunks if browser startup payload becomes the next optimization target.
